pr.title: CS-194: editorial fixes in the registry sections
pr.body:
Closes #153. Change set CS-194.

- **Health Facility Registry**, the "For example" sentence: "facilities whose identifiers do not always match the claims system's provider identifiers" and "whose operational status has not been updated" (PC-1561).
- **Health Facility Registry**: removes the incomplete duplicate bullet "Standards-based access and interoperability." The full bullet stays (PC-1573).
- **Supplier Registry**: the fragmentation passage appeared twice. This keeps the bulleted version, whose hedged wording looks like the later edit, and drops the prose paragraph from the section. The block file stays, so PC-0296 still resolves to the review version. **Reviewer check:** the dropped paragraph's closing line ("the underlying cause is the same: absence of a shared, authoritative supplier identity layer") is not in the bulleted version.
- **product catalogue management tool**: lower-cased in prose and tables, since it is not a DPI-H catalogue component. The bold title "A Comparative View of …" keeps title case (PC-1738).
- **Health Workforce Registry**: says HWWF are the OpenHIE HWR workflows and HWRF its functional requirements, at first use (PC-2586).

Released by Review Change Sets row CS-194, Ready for agent.
